description: A PHP class providing helper methods for displaying and managing statistics templates in Revive Adserver, including day span selection, sorting links, and translations.

classes.name: OA_Admin_Statistics_Flexy
classes.description: Helper class for statistics templates, managing display elements, sorting, and translations.

methods.name: showDaySpanSelector
methods.description: Displays the day span selection form with a day span selector widget.

methods.name: showValue
methods.description: Returns a specific value from an array for display.

methods.name: tr
methods.description: Returns a translated string or the original string if no translation is found.

methods.name: listOrderHref
methods.description: Constructs a URI for changing the sorting order of a list based on a field.

methods.name: listOrderHrefRev
methods.description: Constructs a URI for changing the sorting order with default reversed order.

methods.name: listOrderImage
methods.description: Returns the image URI indicating current sorting order or false if not sorted.
